quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on French Montana and Max B's impact on music
quotes.excerpt: You and French Montana have officially taken over the music game right now.
quotes.quote: Ever since you left me, number one on billboards. Max B in Miami, number two on billboards. That's Max B and French Montana. Max B, listen, you haven't been home a year, a year, and you and French Montana have officially taken over the music game right now.

quotes.speaker: Max B
quotes.summary_phrase: Max B on his new Maybach and the New York celebration
quotes.excerpt: I just went out and bought me a brand new Maybach yesterday.
quotes.quote: Listen, that's what we do. Rapping five. And that ain't nothing. I just went out and bought me a brand new Maybach yesterday. One on their asses out here. Get ready. We outside. Max B's out now.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the tension and beef in New York hip-hop
quotes.excerpt: There's also been a lot of tension, a lot of beef that's been going on.
quotes.quote: We talk about Hov and Biggie, you two guys, like Cam, Ma$e, Jim Jones, all these guys, but it also even 50. But there's also been a lot of tension, a lot of beef that's been going on from that area. And I wanted to know like with the Knicks winning, and like what is a goal of you guys, more of a serious conversation, like to bring that shit, bring that shit all together again.

quotes.speaker: Max B
quotes.summary_phrase: Max B and French Montana on their beef with the French banks
quotes.excerpt: We only got beef with the French banks.

text_blocks.speaker: Max B
text_blocks.text: We only got beef with the French banks.

text_blocks.speaker: French Montana
text_blocks.text: Everything else is, y'all united. Everybody is having a, I feel like New York has come together since the championship.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the lack of respect for Jalen Brunson's greatness
quotes.excerpt: The outside world is still not respecting the greatness that we just witnessed out of Jalen Brunson.
quotes.quote: To me, it feel like, not us, but the outside world is still not respecting the greatness that we just witnessed out of Jalen Brunson on the big stage and throughout these playoffs. How do you two guys feel about Brunson and where he ranks all-time as a Knick? How do you feel about him period overall as a player and you valuing his greatness?

quotes.speaker: French Montana
quotes.summary_phrase: French Montana on Jalen Brunson's status as a top Knicks player
quotes.excerpt: I just think Brunson should never pay for nothing else in New York again.
quotes.quote: I just think Brunson should never pay for nothing else in New York again for the rest of his life. He's definitely top three greatest Knicks ever.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Knicks' championship and the parade
quotes.excerpt: I saw y'all on social media, y'all was doing the video and y'all was like, this is not it.
quotes.quote: I also heard that, I saw y'all on social media, y'all was doing the video and y'all was like, this is not it. We got more fire on the way. You know what I mean? When you, especially when y'all was opening up the plaques, you know what I'm saying? When y'all received the packages, look, I'm following everything. Personally, I'm following everything.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Knicks' 2016 championship team anniversary
quotes.excerpt: A group of the Cavs from the 2016 championship team are celebrating their 10-year anniversary.
quotes.quote: A group of the Cavs from the 2016 championship team are celebrating their 10-year anniversary. I believe, according to social media, they're in Scotland, riding helicopters from golf course to golf course. Here are some of the fun photos that have been taken. You got Channing, of course, there, you got Swish, Tristan, Kevin, Bron. I mean, no big deal. They started in London, they're sleeping in castles.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his role in the 2016 championship team
quotes.excerpt: Tell her I do not want her job. Tell her I promise.
quotes.quote: Tell her I do not want her job. Tell her I promise. Because look, out of every four or five yeses I've gotten, I've gotten probably 75, 80 left on read. So now, we going to keep pushing.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the 2016 Cavs championship team's bond
quotes.excerpt: It just goes to show you how close the group is.
quotes.quote: It just goes to show you how close the group is, right? Because after you win a championship, it's like pretty much sad because you're supposed to be. Right? Like you think I wouldn't have wanted to go on a trip with the 2016 squad? Like why we can't, why we can't get all that shit together? This is a beautiful thing to see. Even if it's only a select few of them right there, like again, when they have their next reunion, then maybe other people will be able to join, right? Like maybe, you know, time heal wounds because, you know, the biggest thing is, is right, like not seeing maybe a Kyrie Irving in there.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the difficulty of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: You know how hard it is to win a damn championship?
quotes.quote: You know how hard it is to win a damn championship? You know how much you got to build around guys throughout the course of a 82-game season? You're around those guys and those individuals more than you're around your own damn family. You know how many times you did bump heads with those guys? Y'all didn't got into arguments, y'all didn't love on one another, y'all didn't came on the bus and not talk to one another, y'all didn't wanted to trade one another. Like all that shit happens throughout the course of that journey.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the importance of trust in winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: The most important thing that you need when you're trying to go win a championship is you need trust.
quotes.quote: The most important thing that you need when you're trying to go win a championship is you need trust. Like, I don't want to, hey man, we got to be careful what we say around you, man. You sure we okay to have film session? Because we don't know what this motherfucker may go say on this thing. Like I feel like Jalen Brunson didn't got to this point. And it makes sense to me. Jalen be the one that came out on his podcast, on his show at All-Star break with Jalen Brunson, and I was telling him, and I asked him in his face, hey, do you know what's in front of you? And you know what sparked that conversation? Did I say this, this say this already, Allie? Did I tell you about this already?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the importance of focus during championship runs
quotes.excerpt: Nothing should be a distraction when you're trying to accomplish the goal of winning the championship.
quotes.quote: I told Jalen Brunson, you can put this to the side until after the season. Nothing should be a distraction when you're trying to accomplish the goal of winning the championship. I don't give a damn if it's your wife, your significant other, your kids, everybody comes second to basketball when you're actually trying to go win a damn championship. He looked at me and said, I feel you.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Jalen Brunson's superstitions
quotes.excerpt: I think he has a little superstition. He didn't want to be seen looking at the trophy.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: The conversation he had with Malika Andrews about getting it done, it was like, I don't want to talk about it.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: I think he has a little superstition. He didn't want to be seen looking at the trophy. He didn't want to be the same guy looking at the Larry O'Brien trophy.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on why Portland didn't retain Chauncey Billups
quotes.excerpt: I thought they were going to bring him back and give him a real contract.
quotes.quote: I like what Chauncey Billups done in Portland. He had an excellent year. Granted, given with all what was going on in Portland, I was surprised they didn't bring him back. I thought they were going to bring him back and give him a real contract. They didn't want to give him a real contract. I'm not surprised getting to know how the owner is operating. I'm not surprised by that.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Taylor Jenkins' coaching style
quotes.excerpt: He's a great coach. I think he's great for the situation if they're about to rebuild.
quotes.quote: I know Taylor Jenkins well too. I had him in Memphis. He was a great coach. I like him a lot and I think he's great for the situation if they're about to rebuild if Giannis leaves. He's going to get some guys in there that's coachable, build an environment. I think that's where Memphis started going wrong when Taylor was let go and everybody else kind of was traded away. They were able to be coached by Taylor. Like they liked Taylor a lot.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the value of young coaching hires
quotes.excerpt: I always like the new hires. I get tired of rotating suits.
quotes.quote: I like young, new blood. I love that Chauncey Billups is still young, but you look at Wes Unseld Jr., he was 39, Mark Daigneault was 41, and I know Mike Brown is a little older, but he has that personality. I always like the new hires. I get tired of rotating suits. There's no knock on other guys like a Tom Thibodeau, but I always like the new hires. I like this for Chauncey Billups, excuse me, I like this for Chauncey Billups, I like this for Wes Unseld Jr. I get tired of rotating suits.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the importance of personality in coaching
quotes.excerpt: It's more than just X's and O's when it comes down to how you're able to relate.
quotes.quote: It's more than just X's and O's when it comes down to how you're able to relate to get the ears of a locker room now. You got to have that personality. You got to be able to talk with these guys and be able to relate to get your message across in some sort of a fun way. And the only way that you're going to be able to do that is by having the personality and being young.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the risks of coaching in Portland
quotes.excerpt: If you watch this new owner do what he just did to Chauncey Billups, do you really want to go?
quotes.quote: If you're a person that wants to be a head coach and you watch this new owner do what he just did to Chauncey Billups, do you really want to go to that organization? Not because of the players, but because of the owner. Do you really want to be up under that? Because if Chauncey Billups is getting let go, I got to have some shit in writing. I got to have something to let me know that I'm okay.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Rajon Rondo's basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: He's a genius mind when it comes to the game.
quotes.quote: He's a genius mind when it comes to the game. He's going to watch the game two or three times. He's going to give you different perspective and be like, what? And things you just didn't see. So yeah, Rondo is definitely, he's a genius when it comes to the sport.
